**Coaching note:**
When your opponent moves a piece to attack you, check if it's undefended. Here, White's knight jumped to e5 but has no protection. A forcing check (Qd4+) pulls the king away, then you simply capture the loose piece. In-between checks win material! Always scan for forcing moves before accepting threats—they often crack open the position.
